blocks.html:
MOOC (Massive Open Online Courses) are free online courses open to everyone.

eLab is responsible for the design, production, and publication of USI MOOCs, in collaboration with the respective scientific directors.

The following MOOCs or online courses are currently available online:

  • eTourism: Communication Perspectives (EN) - Scientific responsibility of Prof. Lorenzo Cantoni.
  • Reaching UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) through Systems Thinking (EN) - MOOC promoted by the University of Bergen, with the collaboration of Prof. Paulo Gonçalves
  • Emergencies and Resilience (EN) - Scientific responsibility of. Prof. Paulo Gonçalves
  • Switzerland Travel Academy 2.0 (EN) - Promoted by Switzerland Tourism

Other MOOCs produced by eLab, which are not currently available online:

  • All'eterno dal tempo. La Commedia di Dante (IT) - Scientific responsibility of Prof. Stefano Prandi
  • Tourism Management at UNESCO World Heritage Sites (vol. 1) (EN) - Scientific responsibility of Prof. Lorenzo Cantoni
  • Tourism Management at UNESCO World Heritage Sites (vol. 2) (EN) - Scientific responsibility of Prof. Lorenzo Cantoni
  • Tourism Management at UNESCO World Heritage Sites (vol. 3) (EN) - Scientific responsibility of Prof. Lorenzo Cantoni
  • Mario Botta: To Be an Architect (EN) - Scientific responsibility of eLab
  • Religions from the Inside. Improving Interreligious Dialogue (EN) - Promoted by Prof. Adriano Fabris, Faculty of Theology of Lugano
